hamilton-matrix-equations-5eeea853.title: Matrix Form of Hamilton’s Equations
hamilton-matrix-equations-5eeea853.interpretation: Unifies the canonical equations of motion into a single first-order matrix differential equation acting on the phase space vector $\mathbf{z} = (\mathbf{q}, \mathbf{p})$.
hamilton-matrix-equations-5eeea853.symmetry_origin: The symplectic geometry of the phase manifold, where motion is treated as a gradient flow through a non-Euclidean metric.
hamilton-matrix-equations-5eeea853.limits_and_boundary: Equivalent to the 2n coupled equations of motion; requires the non-singular nature of the symplectic matrix J.

gross-pitaevskii-equation-condensate-afc.title: Gross-Pitaevskii Equation
gross-pitaevskii-equation-condensate-afc.interpretation: A non-linear Schrödinger equation that describes the mean-field wave function of a Bose-Einstein condensate, accounting for external potentials and inter-particle interactions through the coupling constant g.
gross-pitaevskii-equation-condensate-afc.symmetry_origin: The minimization of the energy functional for a macroscopic quantum state of interacting bosons.
gross-pitaevskii-equation-condensate-afc.limits_and_boundary: In the limit of zero interaction (g=0), it reduces to the single-particle Schrödinger equation for the ground state.
